subject: Engineering decisions
title: remote-chat-agent baseline and `rca-edge`
question: What was measured for remote-chat-agent baseline and `rca-edge`?
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: Reported observations and context: Baseline, plan and first slice are in `docs/audits/2026-10-06-rca-baseline-and-rust-migration-plan.md`. Numbers: TS service 2.9 to 3.1 s to first `/health`, 237 MB idle; `rca-edge` answers `/health` in 0.48 ms p50 (Node 1.09) from 2.2 MB, and tunnels the rest. Decision: strangler front door in std-only Rust rather than a framework, so the binary stays 334 KB and carries no dependency to vet; routes move one group per PR.
